note: English translations of the demo20 Chinese queries by DeepSeek deepseek-v4-flash through a Dify workflow on 2026-10-11 (temperature 0, max_tokens 1024, reasoning separated). Prompt: translate faithfully, keep identifiers, file names, commands and product names, add nothing, do not answer, output only the translation. One run per query, except d15: its first run returned an empty string because reasoning used all 1024 tokens (finish_reason length); three reruns gave two different wordings and one more empty output, and the first non-empty one is kept.
